info.name: BuildLead CRM API
info.description:
BuildLead CRM backend (Laravel). Run **Auth → Login (admin)** first; it stores the bearer token in `{{token}}`.

Set `ingestToken` to `LEAD_INGEST_TOKEN` from `backend/.env` for the webhook requests.

request.description: Sales reps only see their own leads.

item.name: Ingest (public webhook)
item.description: `POST /ingest/{website|email|call}` with the `X-Ingest-Token` header. Rate limited per IP (INGEST_RATE_PER_MINUTE). German or English field names are both accepted.
